note: Independent of the document suite: no shared passages, questions or answer strings. Asked the way an owner would in chat; the prompts never ask for quotes.

passages.garden: The Elm Street community garden has 32 plots. Each plot rents for $40 per season. Water is shut off from November to March. Every member works one volunteer shift each season. The waiting list opens on 1 February.
passages.makerspace: The makerspace at Harbor Library has two 3D printers and a laser cutter. Members book the laser cutter in 90-minute blocks. Children under 14 need an adult with them. Printing filament is free, and acrylic sheets cost $5 each.
passages.detour: Route 12 will detour around Pine Avenue from 3 to 14 June while the bridge is repaired. During the detour, buses stop on Cedar Street instead. Evening service ends at 10:30 p.m. until the bridge reopens. Fares do not change.

tasks.question: How much does a plot cost per season?
How long can I book the laser cutter for?
Where do the buses stop during the detour?
How much does the bridge repair cost?

tasks.message: Suggest one name for a houseplant, in one short sentence.
